_doc: Task 6T section 6.3. Frozen held-out stress pack, created BEFORE training; never extended after observing model failures. Every canonical class is represented by 4 Chinese and 4 English prompts using held-out template/lexical forms, including a minority of held-out synonyms (占地面积最大/占地面积最小/楼房区域; most extensive/least extensive/structure).
